SYNN.title: Synthetic Neocloud says demand for AI capacity remains strong
SYNN.summary: The chief executive said customer contracts are intact and called the selloff a reaction to sector worries rather than company problems.
SYNN.raw:
# Synthetic Neocloud CEO says demand for AI capacity remains strong
![CEO interview](https://image.cnbcfm.com/api/v1/image/synthetic.jpg)
Watch the full interview with the chief executive here.
The chief executive of Synthetic Neocloud said on Wednesday that customer contracts are intact and called the recent selloff a reaction to sector worries rather than company problems.
"We have not seen a single customer cancel," the CEO told CNBC, adding that the company still expects revenue to more than double next year.
He said Synthetic Neocloud would keep investing in new GPU clusters even if the shares stay volatile.

SYNN.title: Neocloud stocks slide as investors question AI data-center spending
SYNN.summary: Shares of Synthetic Neocloud and other GPU cloud providers fell again as investors questioned how long hyperscaler AI capex can keep growing.
SYNN.raw:
![Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/resizer/logo.png)
Advertisement · Scroll to continue
Oct 21 (Reuters) - Shares of Synthetic Neocloud fell 9% on Tuesday, extending a slide that has also hit other GPU cloud providers, as investors questioned how long hyperscaler AI capex can keep growing.
Synthetic Peer Cloud and other rivals also dropped. "The market is repricing the whole neocloud group," said a portfolio manager at a synthetic fund, who added that some customers may slow their orders.
Analysts said the group's valuations had assumed years of rising AI spending by the largest cloud companies, which now face questions from their own shareholders.
The city council approved a new budget for public parks and libraries on the same day, local officials said in a statement.

SYNN.title: Short seller targets Synthetic Neocloud over debt-funded data-center build-out
SYNN.summary: A short seller said the company relies on borrowing to expand its data centers and that the risks are underestimated; the company rejected the claims.
SYNN.raw:
A short seller published a report on Monday arguing that Synthetic Neocloud relies on borrowed money to build its data centers and that investors underestimate the risks.

The report said the company's borrowing costs could rise quickly if demand for AI computing cools. Synthetic Neocloud rejected the claims and said its customer contracts are long-term.

SYNN.title: Synthetic Neocloud prices $2 billion convertible notes offering
SYNN.summary: The company plans to raise $2 billion in convertible notes to fund new GPU capacity, which could dilute existing shareholders.
SYNN.raw:
AMSTERDAM--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Synthetic Neocloud N.V. (Nasdaq: SYNN) today announced the pricing of $2 billion of convertible senior notes due 2031 in a private offering.
Synthetic Neocloud intends to use the net proceeds to fund new GPU capacity and for general corporate purposes. The notes will be convertible into shares, which could dilute existing shareholders.
About Synthetic Neocloud
Synthetic Neocloud builds AI infrastructure. For more information visit https://www.synthetic.example/investors.

SYNP.title: GPU cloud rival Synthetic Peer Cloud falls after customer concentration warning
SYNP.summary: The company warned that a few large customers account for most of its revenue.
SYNP.raw:
Synthetic Peer Cloud warned on Monday that a few large customers account for most of its revenue, sending its shares sharply lower in early trading.
The warning weighed on other neocloud stocks, including Synthetic Neocloud, as investors worried about how concentrated the demand for rented AI computing really is.

SYNQ.title: Chip supplier Synthetic Q says AI orders remain strong
SYNQ.summary: Management said orders from cloud customers are holding up despite the market swings.
SYNQ.raw:
Chip supplier Synthetic Q said on Tuesday that orders from cloud customers, including Synthetic Neocloud, are holding up despite the market swings.
Management said it sees no sign that the largest buyers are cutting their AI hardware budgets this quarter.
